title: Merchant Presets — Shops for 5e
description:
Ready-made shops for dnd5e. Drag a shop out of the compendium, drop its token, and your players can shop. No other modules required.

  • A window of its own: stock by category, a running bill of sale with the buyer's purse, and a Sell tab that shows what the shop pays for each item and what it won't touch.
  • Shops that behave like shops: rolled stock that sells out and restocks on its own schedule, a till that can run dry, trading hours on the world clock, and merchants who only buy what they deal in.
  • Village, town and city: every shop in three sizes, stocked and priced to match, with magic items up to rare in the cities.
  • Services as goods: meals, lodging, stabling, passage and spellcasting, sold like any item; a bought spell is announced in chat and a bought mount arrives as an actor.
  • The GM in charge: a Settings tab for rates, category rules, per-character deals, hours, restocks and the till, and Set up as shop… to turn any NPC into one.
  • Trades that hold: carried out on the GM's side, so two players can't both buy the last one, with a receipt in chat.

Built entirely from SRD 5.2 (CC-BY-4.0), so it works in any dnd5e world and redistributes no paid content. Inspired by The Inspired Arcana's free homebrew shop guide.

recommends.reason: Opening a shop at its counter wraps two of core's token methods; libWrapper keeps that clear of other modules' own wraps. Without it the module patches them itself.
